breakpoints.note: libpcap accepts the staged witness as a readable classic pcap, so project code proceeds to query its link-layer type and read the first packet.
Source. This is the first project statement that turns attacker-controlled file bytes into the invalid link-layer dispatch key later consumed by packet parsing.

The staged fix adds `RawPacket::isLinkTypeValid()` and rejects the same transformed `pcap_datalink()` value before assignment. With no validation here, the unsupported dispatch key continues into Packet::createFirstLayer() and the downstream misparse path stays reachable.
